crossRefs.note: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
Your lips are like scarlet thread. Your mouth is lovely. Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your…
Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,
Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.
You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.
Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about, to minister in; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
